_about: Option generators: citywide calendars, venues and teams whose listings feed the 'Coming up' list. Hand-edited. Unlike orgs.json these are not groups we follow — they are where the options come from. Same fields as an org entry; `kind` and `reach` are defaults applied when a listing gives no better clue. tools/milwaukee/build.py reads this and writes events.json; it never writes this file. Probed 2026-09-13: Pabst Theater Group, Fiserv Forum, Summerfest, OnMilwaukee's and Milwaukee Record's listings, County Parks, and Visit Milwaukee are app-rendered or blocked to feed readers — link-only until that changes.

sources.name: Urban Milwaukee calendar
sources.what: The broadest public calendar in town: venues, nonprofits and promoters post here directly.
